programs.name: SaskEnergy: high-efficiency gas furnace
programs.rules: Natural gas, part of the primary heating system, not new construction, TSASK-licensed gas contractor. Apply within 120 days.

programs.rules: Per boiler plant up to 300 MBH. Natural gas, TSASK-licensed gas contractor.

programs.name: SaskPower Energy Assistance Program
programs.rules: Homeowners, renters and landlords. Check your eligibility online. Not added to your total.

programs.name: National Heat Pump Rebate (federal, not open yet)
programs.rules: Announced October 8, 2026 and expected to launch in early 2027. The income line, eligible homes and how it combines with provincial programs are not published, so this is shown but not added to your total.

notes: We found no provincial heat pump, insulation or window rebate in Saskatchewan. That is a negative result, not proof none exists.
Amounts are the most a program pays. Your rebate depends on your quote and final invoice.
